L4.name: workload-fast
L4.note: Real, uninstrumented llama-cli wall-clock (Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0, 6-token prompt, 128 generated tokens, -ngl 99), same env fingerprint (env-68d8b007) for baseline and final. Prompt: 622.7 -> 635.8-653.5 t/s (+2-5%). Generation: 71.9 -> 77.6 t/s (+7.9%). Gains driven by the getrows (host-round-trip removal) and flash-attn-vec (split-KV, up to 15.02x on isolated decode-shape kernel bench) optimizations; the mmvq fused fast-path optimization was trialed and reverted after a done-phase e2e regression showed it does not generalize to this model's actual matmul dims (see optimization/mmvq.json).

waivers.blast_radius: Multi-GPU --split-mode tensor/layer across >1 SYCL device is unavailable. Does not affect the single-device qwen3 e2e workload this migration targets.

waivers.reason: ggml_backend_sycl_host_buffer_type falls back to the plain CPU buffer type instead of a USM host-pinned allocation.
waivers.blast_radius: H2D/D2H transfer bandwidth for pinned-buffer paths (e.g. some KV cache offload configs) is lower than an optimized pinned allocation would give; correctness is unaffected.

waivers.reason: FLASH_ATTN_EXT SYCL migration in this pass implements only the F16 KV-cache path. Q8_0 KV-cache instances (f16-q8_0, q8_0-f16, q8_0-q8_0) are deferred.
waivers.blast_radius: Q8_0 KV-cache flash-attention falls back to CPU; only F16 KV-cache FLASH_ATTN_EXT is SYCL-accelerated. Dense Qwen3-class inference with default F16 KV cache is covered.
